en: A multi‑view color postcard with three photographs. The large left image shows a park with people sitting and relaxing around a tall monument topped by a winged angel statue, surrounded by lush trees. The upper-right image shows a stone lion sculpture on a pedestal, set against greenery and blue sky. The lower-right image shows a busy city intersection with cyclists and pedestrians in front of a tall stone column monument; modern buildings line the streets around it. The word "NIJMEGEN" is printed in red between the right-hand images.
